notes: Gaps for the owner: (1) A save the log answers SaveNotConfirmed keeps its files; if `cma case check` then shows the entry was not recorded, a re-import of the same file says 'already imported' because inputs/ holds it by hash, so the import is stranded without a log entry. Needs a design decision (e.g. dedupe by log entry, not by inputs/ file). (2) The import work folder is a TemporaryDirectory inside the case folder; a hard crash mid-import can leave a tmp* folder holding the export (owner-only, but not cleaned on next start). (3) `cma case check` takes a folder path while new/profile/import take a case id. (4) `cma case profile` list options can replace but not clear a list from the CLI (only via --from). (5) Windows: chmod-based owner-only has no effect on NTFS ACLs; permission tests are POSIX-only.
